configuration.fit: TMLE(outcome_learner=<outcome learner>, treatment_learner=<treatment learner>, learned_rule=LearnedRule(), cross_fit=True, n_folds=5, cv_evaluation=True, targeting_scheme='pooled', g_bounds='auto', q_bounds=<(0.0, 1.0) on the beta outcome, None on the binary one>, simultaneous=False, random_state=<fold seed>).fit(frame, outcome='Y', treatment='A', covariates=['W1', 'W2', 'S'], strata=['S'], weights=<'w' in a weighted setting>); n = 1000, rows only, complete data, repeats=1
configuration.outcome_learner: Pipeline(PolynomialFeatures(2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False), QuasiBinomialGLM(tol=1e-10)) on (A, W1, W2, S) for the beta outcome; the same products with LogisticRegression(C=1e6, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-10) for the binary one
configuration.targeting_control_learner: E1's drop_w1_learner(): columns 0 and 2 of (A, W1, W2, S), so A and W2 only, and their product, quasibinomial; it learns a rule of W2 alone, and the truth is refit with it
configuration.law: the law of tests/studies/_fold_evaluated_strata_law.py: W1 ~ U(-1, 1), W2 ~ Bernoulli(0.5), logit g0 = 0.3 W1 - 0.2 W2, Y | A, W ~ Beta(12 m, 12 (1 - m)) with blip b = 0.1 + 1.5 W1 (unweighted, weighted; rule boundary W1 = -1/15 in stratum 1) or Bernoulli(m) with b = -1.2 + 3.0 W1 (binary_steep, binary_steep_weighted; boundary W1 = 0.4 in stratum 2), m = Qbar0(A, W), logit Qbar0 = 0.2 + 0.5 W1 - 0.3 W2 + a b; S = 0, 1, 2 on W1 in [-1, -0.6), [-0.6, 0.1), [0.1, 1] (shares 0.2, 0.35, 0.45); weighted settings w = 1 + 1.5 W2
configuration.truth: per replication: refit each fold's plug-in rule on the fold's training rows with the fit's outcome learner, task and scaled outcome; require it on every validation row (rule L4) and the stored fold rule on every row; integrate Qbar0(d_v(W), W) over each stratum's interval of W1 by the trapezoid rule on 4001 points for each W2, weighted by w(W2); each stratum truth is the mean over the 5 folds, and the marginal truth is the share mixture
configuration.weak_margin_diagnostic: binary rows-only laws with the blips 0.1 - 0.3 W1 (E1's binary_unweighted, drawn by E1's draw) and -0.6 + 1.5 W1, n = 1000: the declared fit and the same estimator without strata= (same learner and fold seed, so the same folds and fold rules) on each sample, each with its harness; role diagnostic, no verdict
configuration.margin_measures: boundary_disagreement: share of the boundary stratum's rows on which the stored fold rules disagree; boundary_treated_share: share of them the fit's rule treats; descriptive
configuration.oracle_se: sqrt(V^-2 sum_v Var D_{s,v} / n_v) at each fold's rule, by the same quadrature; descriptive
